description: THE AST-VERSUS-REGEX CASE. One harness whose only apparent assertions are comments, string literals and output formatting. It prints a perfect '58/58 assertions passed' line and exits 0, so the assertion-evidence contract reads a positive count and every earlier guard passes it. Its source contains no executable assertion callsite, so it must fail with CORROBORATION_NO_EXECUTABLE_ASSERTIONS. A regex over source text counts several matches in this file; the parser produces no node for a comment and never mistakes a string literal for a call, which is why this layer uses the TypeScript compiler API.
